gbm_population_evidence.quote: Relapsed Solid Tumor; Refractory Solid Tumor
Participants with any relapsed/refractory malignant solid tumor (excluding lymphoma), including central nervous system tumors, that have progressed on standard therapies.

candidate_evidence.quote: The study's purpose is to see if the drug, abemaciclib, is safe and effective when given with other drugs to kill cancer cells.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants with any relapsed/refractory malignant solid tumor (excluding lymphoma), including central nervous system tumors, that have progressed on standard therapies.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetics (PK): Area Under the Concentration Versus Time Curve From Time Zero to Tlast (AUC0-tlast) of Abemaciclib in Part A

role_evidence.quote: A Study of Abemaciclib (LY2835219) in Combination With Other Anti-Cancer Treatments in Children and Young Adult Participants With Solid Tumors, Including Neuroblastoma
Irinotecan: 50 mg/m²/day, administered IV on Days 1-5 of each cycle.
Temozolomide: 150 mg/m²/day, administered orally on Days 1-5 of each cycle.
Temozolomide: 100 mg/m²/day, administered orally on Days 1-5 of each cycle.
Dinutuximab: 17.5mg/m²/day, administered IV on Days 2-5 of each cycle.
Granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor (GM-CSF): 250 μg/m²/day, administered subcutaneously (SC) on Days 6-12 of each cycle.

agents.drug_class_hint: granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor (e.g. sargramostim), immunotherapy adjunct to dinutuximab

coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult solid-tumour basket (Parts A/B age <=18, Part C <21). Glioblastoma appears only in keywords; conditions, title, inclusion criteria and arm labels do not name it, so not_glioblastoma under C7/D27B (would otherwise be basket_gbm_eligible). Temozolomide coded established_therapy_experiment under R2 because its dose differs between arms (100 vs 150 mg/m2 in Part B); it is otherwise a backbone in every arm. Irinotecan, dinutuximab and GM-CSF treated as backbone partners; abemaciclib is the investigational agent. PK is plasma AUC only.
